name: Virginia
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Virginia's land extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): the Cumberland Gap corner in the west, the North Carolina line in the south, the Potomac in the north, and Chincoteague on the Eastern Shore in the east. The east edge stops at the barrier islands, so no open Atlantic is paid for; the lower Chesapeake inside the box cannot be trimmed with a rectangle. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-va.
